description: This file defines a custom exception class, AttributePointerInvalidException, which indicates that an attribute pointer (JSON pointer) is invalid in the context of a Ditto-based application. It includes nested builder class for constructing instances and methods for creating exceptions from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: AttributePointerInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception for invalid attribute pointers, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ThingException. It provides various static methods for instantiation and a nested Builder class for fluent construction.

classes.name: AttributePointerInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing AttributePointerInvalidException instances, allowing setting of message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for AttributePointerInvalidException, initialized with a given JSON pointer.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AttributePointerInvalidException with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AttributePointerInvalidException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers, preserving other properties.
